key_insight: A coordinated paid-content network places promotional articles on UGC platforms and gains substantial visibility in generative-engine answers.
engineering_relevance: Defenses against coordinated promotional content need account- and platform-level signals, not just content-level screening.
method: Mapped one paid-content operation across three major Chinese UGC platforms.
Analyzed account growth, cross-platform campaigns, and evolving listicle content.
Evaluated network citations across nine generative engines and client mentions across eight.
evidence_signal: The study identified 1,985 associated accounts and 466,357 inferred promotional placements; network content accounted for 4.5%–20% of retrievable cited pages, while clients appeared in 52% of answers versus 68% for category leaders.
watch_item: Findings concern one network, and citation attribution varies with attribution strictness; inferred placements should not be treated as individually verified promotions.
paper_title: GEOHunter: Mapping a Generative Engine Optimization Network in the Wild
